faq.q: Where is the Trinidad Carnival 2027 Glam Hub?
faq.a: At the Hilton Hotel, Port of Spain. Shuttle, getting-dressed assistance, breakfast and refreshments and coffee and tea are included with every booking.

faq.q: What can I book on this page?
faq.a: Makeup only and makeup and photoshoot for Carnival Monday, Carnival Tuesday or both days, and photoshoot only for Carnival Monday or Carnival Tuesday. Prices run from US$160 to US$480.
Appointments start every hour from 04:00 to 08:00 Trinidad time on Monday 8 February 2027 and Tuesday 9 February 2027, with 3 places per time. A both-days booking holds one time on each day.
You pay the full price securely on Stripe when you book. Prices are fixed and there are no discount codes.

Full payment is taken at booking. We reserve the right to require full payment at the time of booking for certain services, add-ons, group bookings or promotional rates. Where this applies, it is stated at checkout. Cancellation within 14 days of the Event. No refund is given if you cancel within 14 days before the Event. Bookings made within this period are non-refundable in full. A deposit or booking may be transferred to another Carnival Glam Hub event within 12 months of the original Event date. This includes transfers between territories, subject to availability at the receiving Hub. A transfer is allowed once per booking. A transfer must be requested at least 3 days before the Event. Requests made inside that window are not accepted. Please register at the Hub no later than 30 minutes before your confirmed appointment time. A 15 minute grace period applies from your confirmed appointment time. The full Terms are at https://www.carnivalglamhub.com/policies.
Only the catalogue's standard makeup and photoshoot services are sold on this page. Hair, Full Glam, Gabby Glam Team, bronzing and add-ons are not sold on this page.

faq.q: What if I am late for my time?
faq.a: Please register at the Hub no later than 30 minutes before your confirmed appointment time. A 15 minute grace period applies from your confirmed appointment time. After the grace period has passed, we may shorten your service to fit the remaining time, or cancel the appointment. Where the appointment is cancelled, all payments made are forfeited. A shortened service is charged at the full booked price. Carnival morning runs to a fixed schedule and time released to a late arrival is taken from the masquerader booked after them. Late arrival and early departure. Refunds are not provided if you arrive late for your appointment, or if you choose to leave before receiving the service.

faq.q: Can I get a refund or change my time?
faq.a: The deposit is non-refundable in all circumstances. Cancellation within 14 days of the Event. No refund is given if you cancel within 14 days before the Event. Bookings made within this period are non-refundable in full. No shows and same-day cancellations. If you do not attend your appointment, or cancel on the day of the Event, all payments made are forfeited. No transfer and no credit is issued. Where a refund is approved at our discretion, it is returned by the original payment method and may take up to 30 days to reach you. Payment processing fees are not refundable. Where the schedule allows, one change of appointment time within the same Event may be permitted if requested at least 3 days before the Event. Time changes are subject to availability and are not guaranteed. Carnival morning schedules fill early and a preferred replacement slot may not exist.

faq.q: Will I be ready before my band leaves?
faq.a: Appointments start every hour from 04:00 to 08:00 Trinidad time on Monday 8 February 2027 and Tuesday 9 February 2027, with 3 places per time. A both-days booking holds one time on each day. The venue is the Hilton Hotel, Port of Spain. We do not accept responsibility for missed appointments caused by traffic, transport, road closures, band schedules or any other circumstance outside the Hub. No band's departure time or completion time is promised.

faq.q: What time zone are the times in?
faq.a: All appointment times are Trinidad time, UTC minus 4.

faq.q: Where is the Carnival Glam Hub in Jamaica?
faq.a: The Carnival Glam Hub for Jamaica Carnival 2027 is at The Jamaica Pegasus Hotel, 81 Knutsford Boulevard, New Kingston, Kingston 5, Jamaica. The hotel is next to Emancipation Park. It is a Full Service Glam Hub.

faq.q: How much is carnival makeup in Jamaica?
faq.a: Makeup only is US$200 per masquerader for Jamaica Carnival 2027. Makeup and photoshoot is US$320, Full Glam, which is makeup, hair and photoshoot, is US$440, and prices run from US$120 to US$440. US$50 secures your appointment.

faq.q: What is included at the Jamaica Glam Hub?
faq.a: Every appointment comes with shuttle, wing and bag check while you are with us, space permitting, breakfast and refreshments, alcohol, seamstress, getting-dressed assistance, changing room and coffee and tea. Makeup, Hair, Bronzing and Photoshoot are the services you choose and pay for.

faq.q: Is there a shuttle to the band?
faq.a: Yes. The shuttle runs in Jamaica and comes with every Full Service Glam Hub appointment at the Jamaica Pegasus Hotel.

faq.q: Can I book hair for Jamaica Carnival?
faq.a: Yes. Hair only is US$120, and Full Glam, makeup, hair and photoshoot together, is US$440.

faq.q: What times are available, and what time should I arrive?
faq.a: Appointment start times run from 4:00am to 12:00 noon on Sunday 4 April 2027. Please register at the Hub no later than 30 minutes before your confirmed appointment time. A 15 minute grace period applies from your confirmed appointment time. After the grace period has passed, we may shorten your service to fit the remaining time, or cancel the appointment. Where the appointment is cancelled, all payments made are forfeited.
